Design authority: docs/delivery/workspace-design.md, sections 2, 10 landing 0, 11.5. Visual references: mockups/workspace-vision-2026-09-22/README.md.
Repository owner: storyatlas4s. Delivery boundary: independent foundation.
Integration parent: bd-01M1C2TW7DN3CMTZF2FD0K9FXD; parent relationship does not itself block execution.
Entry dependencies: none; bounded work is ready to claim.

REUSE, SCOPE AND PRESERVATION
Reuse current source/draft editions, Voyage, features, smoke courts and delayed build-alias registration. Own only baseline execution/evidence and bounded diagnosis; no redesign or provider upgrade. Use isolated exact StoryModel/Intaglio/grakern checkouts and distinguish declared pins from overrides.

ACCEPTANCE AND FAILURE WITNESSES
1. Archive actual compileAll/testAll/scalafmtCheckAll/app/fastLinkJS results and applicable source/Voyage/static/feature checks with exact revisions, commands, totals, warnings, failures and skips.
2. Prove which Atlas aliases/tasks executed; prior 245-test or 260-check receipts are historical, not a new pass.
3. Run project-browser ownership audits and retain scoped screenshots where the baseline needs browser execution. Report blockers rather than weakening tests.

EVIDENCE
Record exact producer/consumer/dependency revisions, fixture digests, actual commands/results and warnings/skips. Apply design section 11.5 and AGENTS.md to the changed runtime boundary, including compileAll testAll scalafmtCheckAll app/fastLinkJS and relevant existing/new browser courts for shell changes; use isolated siblings and session-owned project browsers. Documentation-only or human-study evidence is scoped as such. New test names are specifications until implemented and run. No inference, calibration, hosted CI, publication or release is certified by ticket creation.

FALLBACK
No source behavior changes; preserve prior receipts separately from the new dated baseline.

Coordinate one implementation writer and one heavy build at a time. Reserve exact paths when taking the ticket; do not claim other writers' scopes. Keep scientific operations in StoryModel, reuse this application and preserve unrelated edits.
set.title: [Workspace] Qualify the current runtime and publication baseline
